benchmark.cross_user_temporal_disclosure: Per-user chronology only: other users' Train events can be later than this user's held-out events. Cross-user future information is accepted for this educational offline benchmark; it is not a globally leakage-free production-time evaluation.
benchmark.scope: Six independent Validation retrievers; no RRF/ranker execution

isolated_environment.real_data_training_replays: All six models were trained, reloaded and evaluated here from the lock; candidates and per-query metrics match the main environment byte-for-byte.

limitations: Accepted cross-user future-information exposure under per-user chronology; not a global deployment-time benchmark.
Observed rating submissions are not consumption/exposure; missing pairs are unknown, not verified negatives.
Single fixed configuration/seed per model; replicas verify reproducibility and are not hyperparameter tuning.
Cold-positive Validation subgroup has zero eligible queries; metrics are undefined.
Strict source/dependency compatibility is intentional; loading requires the recorded compatible code/library versions.
Frozen DVC metadata retained; pyproject/uv.lock dependency hashes changed, so do not regenerate small_v1 under the new training lock.
Phase 4 must train separate historical snapshot retrievers before leakage-aware LambdaMART examples.
